title: AEGIS2.0: A Diverse AI Safety Dataset and Risks Taxonomy for Alignment of LLM Guardrails

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated collectively under the 'Hate/Identity Hate' and 'Harassment' safety categories by measuring the moderation model's F1 score and category prediction accuracy in detecting hateful, derogatory, or discriminatory text against protected racial and ethnic groups on benchmarks like the AEGIS2.0 test split and OpenAI Moderation dataset.
